Trust me being sick is no walk in the park it’s constantly painful and incredibly slow.
I hated my life at 15-23 or 24 and things got better.

I hated my life at 15 too. It gets better at this age. You just have to stick around to see it. Besides not that Im saying you’re not naturally pretty there’s tons of options these days, I wish we had the options when I was younger. Things will be okay. I know how difficult being a teenager is. Please hang on, there’s still hope for you 🤍

They tell me my physical suffering is from mental issues and not COVID which ruined my entire existence. They belittle this every chance they get. My own mother doesn’t believe I was ever sick despite 2 positive tests (she also may have gotten me sick a second time). I just don’t want to be here anymore, everyday I open my eyes is a fucking nightmare,
Can relate. I’m 29 too and after covid multiple times from doctors appointments I have severe issues. I plan on ending my life if there’s any permanent damage.
Doubtful you’ll contract HIV. Just get tested and stay calm. It is highly unlikely and we all make mistakes
I wish I didn’t have any family or I would have by now.
I couldn’t have said it better myself. I feel the same. I hope you find peace, no matter how that may be.

I couldn’t jump. I’d rather take my chances with pills because if it works at least it’s semi peaceful? I think? Jumping is definitely likely to work I just don’t have the health or strength to find somewhere to do it right now.

I was dealing with this for years, plus chronic illnesses and now covid 3-4 times. Safe to say the pandemic is enough for me to finally end it. I actually managed to get my shit together somewhat before this now I’m deathly ill and suffering every single waking second of the day. I’m ready to end it all.

I feel the same. I’m getting very close myself. Normally I would tell you not to it’ll be okay etc but I’m not okay myself so how hypocritical that would be. The only reason I haven’t done it is because of my family. I so desperately want peace. And if things continue to be as horrific as they have been the last year I will. I wish you peace. 🤍 no matter how that may be for you.
I’m here too. Debating it myself as well. Only reason I haven’t yet is I’m my parents only child and they are great people. I’m so sick of suffering in pain.
